business.title: What business is running the campaign?
business.description: e.g. 'a small press in Portland', 'a three-person bakery'.

campaign.title: What are you launching or promoting?
campaign.description: e.g. 'our autumn novel', 'the new spring menu'.

tools.name: campaign_status
tools.description: The whole campaign: the goal and the pace toward it, results by day for the last 8 days with each asset's numbers, the budget against spend by channel, and the calendar for the next 14 days (late items first) with ids, owners and stages. Call it first when asked how the campaign or a day is doing, what is going out, or what is left to spend.

tools.name: set_campaign
tools.description: Save the campaign itself: name, goal, audience, what the goal counts and the number to reach, launch, start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD), and the budget in dollars. For more or less money pass budgetChange (500 adds $500) and the campaign does the sum; pass budget only to replace the whole budget. Call it as soon as any of these is mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: add_asset
tools.description: Put an asset on the campaign calendar: title, channel, the day it goes out (YYYY-MM-DD), owner and stage. An existing title is updated, never duplicated. When planning several, call it once per asset, as soon as each is decided and before you describe the plan.

tools.name: move_asset
tools.description: Move an asset to another stage (idea, draft, approved, scheduled, live), or give it a new date or owner. To push it later or earlier pass shiftDays and the campaign does the date math. Call it the moment the person says an asset moved.

tools.name: log_result
tools.description: Record an asset's numbers for a day: reach (opens, views or impressions), clicks, and conversions (what the goal counts, such as preorders). day defaults to today. A second report for the same asset and day replaces the first. Call it as soon as the person shares numbers, before you comment on them.

tools.name: log_spend
tools.description: Record money spent, in dollars, on a channel (and an asset when one is named). Each call adds to what was spent; never pass a running total. Call it as soon as the person mentions spending, before you comment on the budget.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Every asset with its channel, date, stage, owner and results.

tools.name: page_move_asset
tools.description: Move an asset to another stage or date.

tools.name: page_log_result
tools.description: Record an asset's numbers for a day.
